title: Booking Windows and Waiting-List Holds for Snowsports School Products
content:
A booking of a Snowsports School product is taken inside a window of calendar days ahead of the session date, and where the product is full the collective may hold a participant in order of asking for a stated number of hours.

## 1. The figures published against each product

The earliest a booking is taken is the most calendar days ahead of the session date shown below; the latest is the fewest calendar days ahead. Where a waiting list is carried, the hold period is the whole hours a waiting participant has to take a place that comes free before it passes on.

| Product | Fewest days ahead | Most days ahead | Waiting list carried | Hold period (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 1 | 120 | yes | 24 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 2 | 120 | yes | 24 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 3 | 120 | yes | 24 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 14 | 180 | yes | 48 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 2 | 120 | yes | 12 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 2 | 180 | no | 12 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 30 | 270 | yes | 72 |

## 2. Both sides of each window

- The All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson has the widest opening at the near end: a booking 1 calendar day ahead of the session falls inside its window, and a booking on the session day itself falls outside it.
- The Elite Performance Camp has the narrowest opening at the near end and the longest reach at the far end: a booking 30 calendar days ahead falls inside its window and one 29 days ahead falls outside it, while a booking 270 days ahead falls inside and one 271 days ahead falls outside.
- The Six-Week Development Programme runs from 14 to 180 calendar days ahead, so a booking 13 days ahead falls outside its window at the near end and one 181 days ahead falls outside it at the far end.

## 3. Hold periods

The hold period runs from 12 hours on the Semi-Private Coaching Session and the Private Instruction Full Day, through 24 hours on the three products at that figure, to 48 hours on the Six-Week Development Programme and 72 hours on the Elite Performance Camp. The Private Instruction Full Day is the one product of the range that carries no waiting list.
